+# Decision: T06-A12 ordinary-column NOT NULL policy proof
+
+Date: 2026-10-15
+Status: Accepted
+Related milestone/version: mysql-tidb-ddl-completion (#79), task T06 / issue #85
+Related commits: T06-A12 proof commit on milestone/mysql-tidb-ddl-completion
+Related tests: `internal/infrastructure/parser/tidb/extractor_t06a12_test.go`, `internal/domain/rule/ddl/not_null_t06a12_test.go`, `internal/application/audit/batch_state_t06a12_test.go`, `pkg/deltascope/audit_column_not_null_t06a12_test.go`, `internal/interfaces/http/audit_column_not_null_t06a12_test.go`, `scripts/test_ddl_golden.py` T06-A12 contract group
+Related docs: `testdata/ddl-golden/T06.json`, `testdata/ddl-inventory/T06-base-traceability.md`, `testdata/ddl-inventory/inventory.yaml`, T06-A12 baseline `/tmp/ds-t06-a12-baseline/`
+
+## Context
+
+The T06-A12 baseline (offline, collected on evidence HEAD `907ce213`)
+proved `ddl.column.not_null.require` already implements the frozen
+semantics on real parser output: a 16-run offline matrix (eight roles ×
+mysql/tidb) plus a real-AST probe showed the ordinary nullable-column
+blocker, the `NOT NULL` pass, the time-like and BLOB/TEXT-family
+exemption paths, per-column attribution on a mixed table, and the three
+distinct rule_summary states (loaded+applicable, loaded+inapplicable,
+absent). No product red existed — what was missing was committed proof:
+the real-extraction → per-column attribution → isolated-profile finding
+identity chain had no dedicated evidence, and no anchored native
+observation bound the stored `IS_NULLABLE` fact to the policy verdict.
+
+## Decision
+
+- **Structural nullability and policy exemption are separate
+  dimensions.** `spec.Column.NotNull` is a declared fact extracted from
+  the AST; `required`/`allow_time_null` are policy switches; the stored
+  `IS_NULLABLE` is a database fact. The proof binds all three
+  independently: a policy `reject` on `CREATE TABLE t (c INT)` does not
+  change the extracted `NotNull=false`, and the anchored replay shows
+  the stored column stays `IS_NULLABLE=YES` — the verdict never rewrites
+  the declaration, and the declaration never falsifies the verdict.
+- **required=false and disabled are different mechanisms.** Under
+  `t06-a12-not-null-not-required-isolated` the rule is loaded
+  (`loaded=1`) but `AppliesTo` returns false (`applicable=0`); under
+  `all-rules-disabled` the rule never loads and `rule_summary` is absent
+  per the existing serialization contract. Neither is "the rule found
+  nothing": `time-exempt`/`text-exempt` are loaded and applicable yet
+  emit zero findings because each column is exempted. All three states
+  are pinned per role.
+- **Mixed tables are evaluated per column.** `time-allow` exempts
+  `time_c DATETIME NULL` and `payload TEXT` without suppressing the
+  `ordinary INT` finding; under `strict` the same input produces two
+  findings in declaration order. Findings carry complete identity
+  (rule_id, level, message, `{table, column, type}` metadata, statement
+  index, location) bound to the owning column — a one-finding count is
+  never sufficient.
+- **Explicit ordinary NULL and omitted nullability share one normalized
+  boolean.** The AST distinguishes `ColumnOptionNull` from no clause;
+  the extractor treats explicit `NULL` as a no-op because NULL is the
+  default nullability, so `spec.Column.NotNull` is `false` for both.
+  This provenance loss is recorded as current behavior, not promoted to
+  an A12 defect, and no provenance field is added.
+- **A policy reject and a native rejection are separate facts.**
+  Anchored `ordinary-nullable`, `time-required`, and
+  `mixed-attribution` cases record the product `reject` verdict *and*
+  the driver-side CREATE success; `time-exempt` and `time-required`
+  share one SQL under opposite verdicts, so role identity is bound by
+  (sql, profile, verdict), never by SQL text alone. `IS_NULLABLE` is
+  observed as stored: the rejected `c`/`ordinary` columns record `YES`,
+  the `NOT NULL` declaration records `NO`.
+- **DATETIME and TEXT are representatives, not the full exemption
+  matrix.** `isTimeLike` covers DATETIME/TIMESTAMP/DATE/TIME/YEAR and
+  `isBlobTextLike` covers the BLOB/TEXT families plus JSON; this slice
+  pins one representative per family and does not claim the matrices.
+- **The A2 primary-key boundary stays intact.** PK members' implicit
+  nullability and the A2 explicit-NULL conflict control are untouched;
+  this slice covers non-PK ordinary columns only and reuses the A2
+  regressions as the isolation control.
+- **No schema changes.** `spec.Column` gains no nullability-provenance
+  field; `rule_summary` gains no field — the `applicable` value was
+  already serialized and is now validated per A12 role.
+
+## Public contract
+
+- Frozen case ids: `t06-a12-{mysql|tidb}-{ordinary-nullable|ordinary-not-null|time-exempt|time-required|text-exempt|mixed-attribution|required-false|disabled}` (offline) and `t06-a12-{mysql57|mysql80|mysql84|tidb85}-{ordinary-nullable|ordinary-not-null|time-exempt|time-required|mixed-attribution}` (anchored), raising T06 to 360 required cases.
+- Message pinned verbatim: `column "<name>" should be declared NOT NULL` (metadata `{table:t, column:<name>, type:<parser-rendered>}`), blocker, statement index 0 at 1:1.
+- Isolated profiles: `t06-a12-not-null-strict-isolated` (`required=true`, `allow_time_null=false`), `t06-a12-not-null-time-allow-isolated` (`required=true`, `allow_time_null=true`), `t06-a12-not-null-not-required-isolated` (`required=false`); `all-rules-disabled` is reused for the disabled control.
+- Anchored structure oracle: ordered `GROUP_CONCAT` of `schema:table:column:DATA_TYPE:ordinal:IS_NULLABLE`, plus independent column count, zero PK constraints, zero primary index parts, no secondary indexes, and InnoDB on MySQL anchors.
+- The rule's shipped defaults (`warning`, `required=true`, `allow_time_null=true`) are unchanged; isolated blocker levels live only in the frozen profiles.
+
+## Deferred / out of scope
+
+Explicitly out of this slice: runtime INSERT NULL behavior, SQL mode,
+TIMESTAMP implicit defaults, expressions/generated columns, the full
+time-like and blob-text-like exemption matrices, ALTER-side nullability
+changes, stored-data validity, PostgreSQL behavior beyond the existing
+coverage-corpus inclusion, explicit-NULL provenance modeling, default
+handling, and any auto-rewrite of rejected declarations.
+
+## Verification evidence
+
+- `go test -count=1 ./internal/infrastructure/parser/tidb ./internal/domain/rule/ddl ./internal/application/audit -run T06A12 -v` — extraction, rule-boundary, audit-attribution, and post-state groups green.
+- `go test -count=1` on `pkg/deltascope` and `internal/interfaces/http` — SDK/HTTP representatives green.
+- `make ddl-golden-validator-test` — contract cases green, including the T06-A12 mutation group (missed/forged blockers, re-attributed and cross-paired findings, same-SQL role swaps, required=false/disabled laundering, weakened profiles, IS_NULLABLE forgeries, column-set/count corruptions, skipped driver replay, denominator shrinkage).
+- `make ddl-golden TASK=T06` — 360/360 on the four frozen anchors; per-case driver replay, ordered column sets, and structure oracles preserved in the artifact.

+// Package audit verifies the T06-A12 ordinary CREATE TABLE non-PK-column
+// NOT NULL audit, the time-like exemption, per-column finding attribution,
+// and the derived-state boundary.
+// input: the frozen A12 CREATE TABLE roles under the isolated profiles
+// through AuditSQL, plus create+alter inputs through the enrich seam
+// output: per-role verdicts, complete finding identity bound to the owning
+// column, the required=false/disabled distinction, and follower pre-state
+// NotNull/Type propagation without back-mutation
+// pos: application-layer contract tests for the frozen T06-A12 oracle (issue #85)
+// note: if this file changes, update this header and module README.md.
+package audit
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	domainpolicy "github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/policy"
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/report"
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/rule"
+	ddlrules "github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/rule/ddl"
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/spec"
+)
+
+const t06A12RuleID = "ddl.column.not_null.require"
+
+// t06A12Policy writes one of the three frozen isolated profiles: strict
+// (allow_time_null=false), time-allow (allow_time_null=true), or
+// not-required (required=false). The all-off profile is the shared
+// disabled control.
+func t06A12Policy(t *testing.T, params string) string {
+	t.Helper()
+	return t05PolicyPath(t, map[string]string{t06A12RuleID: params})
+}
+
+func t06A12Audit(t *testing.T, dialect spec.Dialect, sql, policy string) report.Result {
+	t.Helper()
+	result, err := AuditSQL(context.Background(), Request{
+		SQL: sql, Dialect: dialect, Schema: "golden",
+		ConfigPath: policy, MetadataProvider: &t05AbsentProvider{},
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("%s %q: unexpected error %v", dialect, sql, err)
+	}
+	if len(result.Statements) == 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("%s %q: no statements projected", dialect, sql)
+	}
+	return result
+}
+
+// TestT06A12OfflineRoleMatrix runs the eight frozen roles through AuditSQL
+// under both dialects and pins the complete product contract: verdict,
+// per-column finding identity (rule_id, level, message, bound metadata),
+// the exemption paths, and the distinct required=false/disabled controls.
+func TestT06A12OfflineRoleMatrix(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	strict := "      required: true\n      allow_time_null: false\n"
+	timeAllow := "      required: true\n      allow_time_null: true\n"
+	notRequired := "      required: false\n      allow_time_null: false\n"
+	roles := []struct {
+		name           string
+		sql            string
+		params         string // empty means the all-off control
+		wantFindings   int
+		wantColumn     string
+		wantType       string
+		wantLoaded     int // -1 means rule_summary must be absent
+		wantApplicable int
+	}{
+		{"ordinary-nullable", "CREATE TABLE t (c INT);", strict,
+			1, "c", "int(11)", 1, 1},
+		{"ordinary-not-null", "CREATE TABLE t (c INT NOT NULL);", strict,
+			0, "", "", 1, 1},
+		{"time-exempt", "CREATE TABLE t (c DATETIME NULL);", timeAllow,
+			0, "", "", 1, 1},
+		{"time-required", "CREATE TABLE t (c DATETIME NULL);", strict,
+			1, "c", "datetime", 1, 1},
+		{"text-exempt", "CREATE TABLE t (payload TEXT);", strict,
+			0, "", "", 1, 1},
+		{"mixed-attribution", "CREATE TABLE t (ordinary INT, time_c DATETIME NULL, payload TEXT);", timeAllow,
+			1, "ordinary", "int(11)", 1, 1},
+		{"required-false", "CREATE TABLE t (c INT);", notRequired,
+			0, "", "", 1, 0},
+		{"disabled", "CREATE TABLE t (c INT);", "",
+			0, "", "", -1, 0},
+	}
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		for _, role := range roles {
+			role := role
+			t.Run(string(dialect)+"/"+role.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+				var policy string
+				if role.params == "" {
+					policy = t05PolicyPath(t, map[string]string{})
+				} else {
+					policy = t06A12Policy(t, role.params)
+				}
+				result := t06A12Audit(t, dialect, role.sql, policy)
+				if len(result.Statements) != 1 {
+					t.Fatalf("statements = %d, want 1", len(result.Statements))
+				}
+				statement := result.Statements[0]
+				if statement.Index != 0 || statement.Kind != "ddl" ||
+					statement.RawSQL != role.sql {
+					t.Fatalf("statement identity = %+v, want ddl %q", statement, role.sql)
+				}
+				// rule_summary distinction: required=false keeps the rule
+				// loaded but inapplicable; disabled never loads it.
+				if role.wantLoaded < 0 {
+					if result.RuleSummary != nil {
+						t.Fatalf("rule summary = %+v, want absent for all-off", result.RuleSummary)
+					}
+				} else if result.RuleSummary == nil ||
+					result.RuleSummary.Loaded != role.wantLoaded ||
+					result.RuleSummary.Applicable != role.wantApplicable {
+					t.Fatalf("rule summary = %+v, want loaded=%d applicable=%d",
+						result.RuleSummary, role.wantLoaded, role.wantApplicable)
+				}
+				if len(statement.Findings) != role.wantFindings {
+					t.Fatalf("role %s findings = %+v, want %d", role.name,
+						statement.Findings, role.wantFindings)
+				}
+				if role.wantFindings == 0 {
+					if result.Verdict != report.VerdictPass {
+						t.Fatalf("role %s verdict = %s, want pass", role.name, result.Verdict)
+					}
+					return
+				}
+				finding := statement.Findings[0]
+				wantMessage := `column "` + role.wantColumn + `" should be declared NOT NULL`
+				if finding.RuleID != t06A12RuleID || finding.Level != "blocker" ||
+					finding.Message != wantMessage {
+					t.Fatalf("finding = %+v, want %s blocker %q", finding, t06A12RuleID, wantMessage)
+				}
+				if finding.Metadata["table"] != "t" ||
+					finding.Metadata["column"] != role.wantColumn ||
+					finding.Metadata["type"] != role.wantType {
+					t.Fatalf("finding metadata = %+v, want table=t column=%s type=%q",
+						finding.Metadata, role.wantColumn, role.wantType)
+				}
+				if result.Summary.Blockers != 1 || result.Verdict != report.VerdictReject {
+					t.Fatalf("summary/verdict = %+v/%s, want 1/reject", result.Summary, result.Verdict)
+				}
+			})
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// TestT06A12MixedStrictControl runs the same three-column input under the
+// strict profile: the ordinary column and the time column each own one
+// finding while the TEXT column stays exempt — a whole-entry comparison, not
+// a per-rule count. The reordered control proves a leading exempt column
+// never swallows a later ordinary column's attribution.
+func TestT06A12MixedStrictControl(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	strict := "      required: true\n      allow_time_null: false\n"
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		t.Run(string(dialect)+"/strict-mixed", func(t *testing.T) {
+			result := t06A12Audit(t, dialect,
+				"CREATE TABLE t (ordinary INT, time_c DATETIME NULL, payload TEXT);",
+				t06A12Policy(t, strict))
+			findings := result.Statements[0].Findings
+			if len(findings) != 2 {
+				t.Fatalf("findings = %+v, want ordinary+time_c", findings)
+			}
+			wants := []struct{ column, typ string }{
+				{"ordinary", "int(11)"}, {"time_c", "datetime"},
+			}
+			for i, want := range wants {
+				finding := findings[i]
+				if finding.RuleID != t06A12RuleID || finding.Level != "blocker" ||
+					finding.Message != `column "`+want.column+`" should be declared NOT NULL` ||
+					finding.Metadata["column"] != want.column ||
+					finding.Metadata["type"] != want.typ ||
+					finding.Metadata["table"] != "t" {
+					t.Fatalf("finding[%d] = %+v, want %s %s blocker", i, finding, want.column, want.typ)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+		t.Run(string(dialect)+"/reordered-strict", func(t *testing.T) {
+			// Declaration order governs finding order: a leading time column
+			// never swallows the ordinary column behind it.
+			result := t06A12Audit(t, dialect,
+				"CREATE TABLE t (time_c DATETIME NULL, ordinary INT);",
+				t06A12Policy(t, strict))
+			findings := result.Statements[0].Findings
+			if len(findings) != 2 ||
+				findings[0].Metadata["column"] != "time_c" ||
+				findings[1].Metadata["column"] != "ordinary" {
+				t.Fatalf("findings = %+v, want [time_c, ordinary]", findings)
+			}
+		})
+		t.Run(string(dialect)+"/reordered-time-allow", func(t *testing.T) {
+			result := t06A12Audit(t, dialect,
+				"CREATE TABLE t (time_c DATETIME NULL, ordinary INT);",
+				t06A12Policy(t, "      required: true\n      allow_time_null: true\n"))
+			findings := result.Statements[0].Findings
+			if len(findings) != 1 || findings[0].Metadata["column"] != "ordinary" {
+				t.Fatalf("findings = %+v, want exactly one on ordinary", findings)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// TestT06A12DerivedPreStateCarriesNullability pins that the derived create
+// shape publishes each column's declared NotNull/Type and ordering into the
+// follower statement's pre-state snapshot — for the nullable, not-null,
+// time-exempt, time-required, and mixed inputs. A policy verdict never
+// rewrites the declared fact: the exempted time column stays NotNull=false
+// in the snapshot, and the rejected nullable column is not repaired. The
+// provider is consulted exactly once for golden.t; the follower pre-state is
+// a clone, never a provider re-read or an alias of the source DDL.
+func TestT06A12DerivedPreStateCarriesNullability(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	creates := map[string]struct {
+		sql     string
+		columns []struct {
+			name    string
+			typ     string
+			notNull bool
+		}
+	}{
+		"ordinary-nullable": {"CREATE TABLE t (c INT);", []struct {
+			name    string
+			typ     string
+			notNull bool
+		}{{"c", "int(11)", false}}},
+		"ordinary-not-null": {"CREATE TABLE t (c INT NOT NULL);", []struct {
+			name    string
+			typ     string
+			notNull bool
+		}{{"c", "int(11)", true}}},
+		"time-exempt": {"CREATE TABLE t (c DATETIME NULL);", []struct {
+			name    string
+			typ     string
+			notNull bool
+		}{{"c", "datetime", false}}},
+		"time-required": {"CREATE TABLE t (c DATETIME NULL);", []struct {
+			name    string
+			typ     string
+			notNull bool
+		}{{"c", "datetime", false}}},
+		"mixed-attribution": {"CREATE TABLE t (ordinary INT, time_c DATETIME NULL, payload TEXT);", []struct {
+			name    string
+			typ     string
+			notNull bool
+		}{{"ordinary", "int(11)", false}, {"time_c", "datetime", false}, {"payload", "text", false}}},
+	}
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		for name, role := range creates {
+			role := role
+			t.Run(string(dialect)+"/"+name, func(t *testing.T) {
+				ctx := context.Background()
+				sql := role.sql + "\nALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN next_c INT;"
+				parsed, err := Parse(ctx, sql, dialect)
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				statements, err := Extract(ctx, parsed)
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				if len(statements) != 2 {
+					t.Fatalf("extracted = %d, want 2", len(statements))
+				}
+				provider := &t05AbsentProvider{}
+				state := newBatchState(dialect, "golden", provider)
+				facts, _ := provider.LoadInstanceFacts(ctx, dialect, "golden")
+				enriched, err := state.enrichStatements(ctx, &MetadataRequest{Schema: "golden", Provider: provider},
+					statements, parsed.failures, facts, auditLimits{orderedStatements: 2})
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatal(err)
+				}
+				var snapshot *spec.TableSnapshot
+				if enriched[1].Metadata != nil {
+					snapshot = enriched[1].Metadata.TargetTable
+				}
+				if snapshot == nil || !snapshot.Exists {
+					t.Fatalf("follower pre-state = %+v, want an existing t", snapshot)
+				}
+				if len(snapshot.Columns) != len(role.columns) {
+					t.Fatalf("pre-state columns = %#v, want %d", snapshot.Columns, len(role.columns))
+				}
+				for i, want := range role.columns {
+					column := snapshot.Columns[i]
+					if column.Name != want.name || column.Type != want.typ ||
+						column.NotNull != want.notNull {
+						t.Fatalf("pre-state column[%d] = %#v, want %s %s notNull=%v",
+							i, column, want.name, want.typ, want.notNull)
+					}
+					if &snapshot.Columns[i] == &statements[0].DDL.Columns[i] {
+						t.Fatalf("pre-state column[%d] shares statement storage — must be a clone", i)
+					}
+				}
+				if snapshot.PrimaryKey != nil {
+					t.Fatalf("pre-state pk = %#v, want none", snapshot.PrimaryKey)
+				}
+				// One provider read total for golden.t: the CREATE's own
+				// existence check. The follower reads the derived clone.
+				reads := 0
+				for _, call := range provider.calls {
+					if call == "golden.t" {
+						reads++
+					}
+				}
+				if reads != 1 {
+					t.Fatalf("provider reads for golden.t = %d, want exactly 1", reads)
+				}
+				// The source declaration is never back-mutated by either the
+				// policy verdict or the exemption path.
+				for i, want := range role.columns {
+					if statements[0].DDL.Columns[i].NotNull != want.notNull {
+						t.Fatalf("source column[%d] NotNull mutated to %v, want %v",
+							i, statements[0].DDL.Columns[i].NotNull, want.notNull)
+					}
+				}
+			})
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// TestT06A12PolicyVerdictDoesNotMutateSource pins the audit/immutability
+// boundary on the real evaluation seam: the strict-policy registry rejects
+// the extracted statement, yet the same spec columns the rule just read keep
+// their declared NotNull=false — a verdict is never a rewrite of the audited
+// declaration.
+func TestT06A12PolicyVerdictDoesNotMutateSource(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		t.Run(string(dialect), func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			parsed, err := Parse(ctx, "CREATE TABLE t (c INT, d DATETIME NULL);", dialect)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			statements, err := Extract(ctx, parsed)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if len(statements) != 1 || len(statements[0].DDL.Columns) != 2 {
+				t.Fatalf("extracted = %+v, want one ddl with two columns", statements)
+			}
+			registry := rule.NewRegistry()
+			if err := ddlrules.Register(registry, domainpolicy.Policy{
+				Rules: map[string]domainpolicy.RulePolicy{
+					t06A12RuleID: {Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker,
+						Params: map[string]any{"required": true, "allow_time_null": false}},
+				},
+			}); err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("register: %v", err)
+			}
+			result, err := EvaluateStatements(ctx, registry, statements)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+			}
+			if result.Verdict != report.VerdictReject ||
+				len(result.Statements[0].Findings) != 2 {
+				t.Fatalf("verdict/findings = %s/%+v, want reject with c+d findings",
+					result.Verdict, result.Statements[0].Findings)
+			}
+			// The policy rejected both columns as nullable, yet the declared
+			// facts stay false — a reject is a verdict, never a rewrite.
+			for _, column := range statements[0].DDL.Columns {
+				if column.NotNull {
+					t.Fatalf("column %s NotNull mutated to true by policy reject", column.Name)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+// Package ddl verifies the T06-A12 ordinary CREATE TABLE non-PK-column
+// NOT NULL rule boundaries on synthetic statements.
+// input: synthetic create-table statements exercising the not-null require
+// rule under boundary policies
+// output: required=false/disabled-style non-applicability, the
+// allow_time_null switch, default level/params, invalid-parameter controls,
+// and per-column finding attribution pinned
+// pos: domain DDL rule regression for issue #85 T06-A12

+func t06A12NotNullRule(t *testing.T, cfg policy.RulePolicy) rule.StatementRule {
+	t.Helper()
+	statementRule, err := newColumnNotNullRequiredRule(cfg)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("new rule: %v", err)
+	}
+	return statementRule
+}
+
+var t06A12Strict = policy.RulePolicy{
+	Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker,
+	Params: map[string]any{"required": true, "allow_time_null": false}}
+
+// TestT06A12RequiredFalseAndInvalidParameters pins required=false as a
+// distinct control from a disabled rule — the rule still constructs but
+// applies to nothing — and pins boolParam's strict typing on both params:
+// a non-bool required or allow_time_null fails construction, never coerces.
+func TestT06A12RequiredFalseAndInvalidParameters(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	statement := createTableWithColumns("t", spec.Column{Name: "c", Type: "int(11)"})
+
+	notRequired := t06A12NotNullRule(t, policy.RulePolicy{
+		Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker,
+		Params: map[string]any{"required": false, "allow_time_null": false}})
+	if notRequired.AppliesTo(statement) {
+		t.Fatal("required=false rule must not apply")
+	}
+	if findings, err := notRequired.Evaluate(ctx, statement); err != nil || len(findings) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("required=false findings = %v, err = %v; want none", findings, err)
+	}
+
+	for _, params := range []map[string]any{
+		{"required": "yes"},
+		{"required": true, "allow_time_null": "yes"},
+	} {
+		if _, err := newColumnNotNullRequiredRule(
+			policy.RulePolicy{Enabled: true, Params: params}); err == nil {
+			t.Fatalf("params %v must fail rule construction", params)
+		}
+	}
+}

+// TestT06A12DefaultLevelAndParams pins the shipped defaults: omitted params
+// mean required=true and allow_time_null=true, and an omitted level falls
+// back to warning — never the isolated profiles' blocker.
+func TestT06A12DefaultLevelAndParams(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	statement := createTableWithColumns("t",
+		spec.Column{Name: "c", Type: "int(11)"},
+		spec.Column{Name: "time_c", Type: "datetime"})
+
+	defaulted := t06A12NotNullRule(t, policy.RulePolicy{Enabled: true})
+	findings, err := defaulted.Evaluate(ctx, statement)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+	}
+	if len(findings) != 1 || findings[0].Level != rule.LevelWarning {
+		t.Fatalf("findings = %+v, want one warning under the default level", findings)
+	}
+	if findings[0].Metadata["column"] != "c" {
+		t.Fatalf("finding metadata = %+v, want column c — time_c is exempt by default",
+			findings[0].Metadata)
+	}
+}

+// TestT06A12AllowTimeNullSwitch pins the parameter's two positions on one
+// datetime column: allow_time_null=true exempts the time-like nullable
+// column, allow_time_null=false reports it — the same declaration under two
+// policies is never an exemption borrowed across profiles.
+func TestT06A12AllowTimeNullSwitch(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	statement := createTableWithColumns("t", spec.Column{Name: "c", Type: "datetime"})
+
+	allowed := t06A12NotNullRule(t, policy.RulePolicy{
+		Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker,
+		Params: map[string]any{"required": true, "allow_time_null": true}})
+	if findings, err := allowed.Evaluate(ctx, statement); err != nil || len(findings) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("allow_time_null=true findings = %v, err = %v; want none", findings, err)
+	}
+
+	strict := t06A12NotNullRule(t, t06A12Strict)
+	findings, err := strict.Evaluate(ctx, statement)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+	}
+	if len(findings) != 1 ||
+		findings[0].Message != `column "c" should be declared NOT NULL` ||
+		findings[0].Metadata["type"] != "datetime" {
+		t.Fatalf("allow_time_null=false findings = %+v, want one datetime blocker", findings)
+	}
+}

+// TestT06A12PerColumnAttribution pins per-column ownership on a mixed table:
+// the ordinary nullable column reports, while the time-like and BLOB/TEXT-like
+// columns stay silent — and findings bind the column name and rendered type,
+// never a table-wide flag.
+func TestT06A12PerColumnAttribution(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	statement := createTableWithColumns("t",
+		spec.Column{Name: "ordinary", Type: "int(11)"},
+		spec.Column{Name: "time_c", Type: "datetime"},
+		spec.Column{Name: "payload", Type: "text"})
+
+	allowed := t06A12NotNullRule(t, policy.RulePolicy{
+		Enabled: true, Level: rule.LevelBlocker,
+		Params: map[string]any{"required": true, "allow_time_null": true}})
+	findings, err := allowed.Evaluate(ctx, statement)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+	}
+	if len(findings) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("time-allowed findings = %+v, want exactly one on ordinary", findings)
+	}
+	finding := findings[0]
+	if finding.Metadata["column"] != "ordinary" ||
+		finding.Metadata["table"] != "t" || finding.Metadata["type"] != "int(11)" {
+		t.Fatalf("finding metadata = %+v, want table=t column=ordinary type=int(11)",
+			finding.Metadata)
+	}
+
+	// Under the strict profile the time column joins the report while the
+	// BLOB/TEXT-like column stays exempt — each column is judged on its own
+	// declared facts, in declaration order.
+	strict := t06A12NotNullRule(t, t06A12Strict)
+	findings, err = strict.Evaluate(ctx, statement)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("evaluate: %v", err)
+	}
+	if len(findings) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("strict findings = %+v, want ordinary+time_c", findings)
+	}
+	for i, want := range []string{"ordinary", "time_c"} {
+		if findings[i].Metadata["column"] != want {
+			t.Fatalf("finding[%d] column = %v, want %s", i, findings[i].Metadata["column"], want)
+		}
+	}
+}

+// TestT06A12CreateTableOnlySeam pins that the rule's applicability is the

+		t.Fatalf("alter findings = %v, err = %v; want none", findings, err)
+	}

+// Package tidbparser verifies T06-A12 ordinary CREATE TABLE non-PK-column
+// nullability extraction: the declared facts and the AST option shapes the
+// NOT NULL policy consumes.
+// input: the frozen A12 CREATE TABLE inputs, an explicit-NULL parser-only
+// control, and a reordered mixed-column control, parsed through the real
+// TiDB parser and extractor under both dialects
+// output: Column.Name/Type/NotNull ordering, absent primary key, absent
+// default/on-update flags, and the AST-level distinction between an omitted
+// nullability clause, ColumnOptionNull, and ColumnOptionNotNull
+// pos: infrastructure parser extractor regression for issue #85 T06-A12
+// note: if this file changes, update this header and module README.md.
+package tidbparser
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/pingcap/tidb/pkg/parser/ast"
+
+	"github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/internal/domain/spec"
+)
+
+// parseExtractT06A12 returns both the raw AST statement and the extracted
+// spec so a test can pin the declaration provenance the spec model carries —
+// and the clause shape it deliberately collapses.
+func parseExtractT06A12(t *testing.T, dialect spec.Dialect, sql string) (*ast.CreateTableStmt, spec.Statement) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	parser := New()
+	result, err := parser.Parse(context.Background(), sql)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("parse sql: %v", err)
+	}
+	if len(result.Statements) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("expected 1 ast statement, got %d", len(result.Statements))
+	}
+	create, ok := result.Statements[0].(*ast.CreateTableStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		t.Fatalf("statement is %T, want *ast.CreateTableStmt", result.Statements[0])
+	}
+	wrapped := WrapStatements(result.Statements, result.Warnings)
+	statement, err := wrapped[0].Extractor.Extract(dialect, wrapped[0].RawSQL)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("extract statement: %v", err)
+	}
+	return create, statement
+}
+
+// columnOptionTypes lists the declared column option kind per column, in
+// declaration order — an omitted nullability clause is an absent option, not
+// a ColumnOptionNull.
+func columnOptionTypes(create *ast.CreateTableStmt, columnIndex int) []ast.ColumnOptionType {
+	types := []ast.ColumnOptionType{}
+	for _, option := range create.Cols[columnIndex].Options {
+		types = append(types, option.Tp)
+	}
+	return types
+}
+
+// t06A12Column is the extracted-fact want for one declared column. Type is
+// the parser-rendered text verbatim: `int(11)` is the parser's default
+// display-width rendering for an undeclared width (Length stays -1), and a
+// bare `datetime` renders with Length 19 — neither is a user-declared fsp
+// and neither is a server COLUMN_TYPE oracle.
+type t06A12Column struct {
+	name     string
+	typeText string
+	notNull  bool
+	length   int
+}
+
+var t06A12Inputs = []struct {
+	name    string
+	sql     string
+	columns []t06A12Column
+}{
+	{name: "ordinary-nullable",
+		sql: "CREATE TABLE t (c INT);",
+		columns: []t06A12Column{
+			{name: "c", typeText: "int(11)", notNull: false, length: -1}}},
+	{name: "ordinary-not-null",
+		sql: "CREATE TABLE t (c INT NOT NULL);",
+		columns: []t06A12Column{
+			{name: "c", typeText: "int(11)", notNull: true, length: -1}}},
+	{name: "time-exempt",
+		sql: "CREATE TABLE t (c DATETIME NULL);",
+		columns: []t06A12Column{
+			{name: "c", typeText: "datetime", notNull: false, length: 19}}},
+	{name: "text-exempt",
+		sql: "CREATE TABLE t (payload TEXT);",
+		columns: []t06A12Column{
+			{name: "payload", typeText: "text", notNull: false, length: -1}}},
+	{name: "mixed-attribution",
+		sql: "CREATE TABLE t (ordinary INT, time_c DATETIME NULL, payload TEXT);",
+		columns: []t06A12Column{
+			{name: "ordinary", typeText: "int(11)", notNull: false, length: -1},
+			{name: "time_c", typeText: "datetime", notNull: false, length: 19},
+			{name: "payload", typeText: "text", notNull: false, length: -1}}},
+	{name: "reordered-mixed",
+		sql: "CREATE TABLE t (time_c DATETIME NULL, ordinary INT);",
+		columns: []t06A12Column{
+			{name: "time_c", typeText: "datetime", notNull: false, length: 19},
+			{name: "ordinary", typeText: "int(11)", notNull: false, length: -1}}},
+}

+// TestExtractorT06A12NullabilityFacts pins the extracted per-column facts the
+// NOT NULL policy consumes: name/order/Type/NotNull, an absent primary key,
+// and no default or on-update semantics riding along.
+func TestExtractorT06A12NullabilityFacts(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		for _, tc := range t06A12Inputs {
+			tc := tc
+			t.Run(string(dialect)+"/"+tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+				t.Parallel()
+				_, statement := parseExtractT06A12(t, dialect, tc.sql)
+				if statement.Kind != spec.KindDDL || statement.DDL == nil {
+					t.Fatalf("statement kind = %v, want ddl", statement.Kind)
+				}
+				if len(statement.DDL.Columns) != len(tc.columns) {
+					t.Fatalf("columns = %#v, want %d", statement.DDL.Columns, len(tc.columns))
+				}
+				for i, want := range tc.columns {
+					column := statement.DDL.Columns[i]
+					if column.Name != want.name || column.Type != want.typeText ||
+						column.NotNull != want.notNull || column.Length != want.length {
+						t.Fatalf("column[%d] = %#v, want %s %s notNull=%v length=%d",
+							i, column, want.name, want.typeText, want.notNull, want.length)
+					}
+					if column.HasDefault || column.DefaultIsCurrentTimestamp ||
+						column.OnUpdateCurrentTimestamp {
+						t.Fatalf("column[%d] = %#v carries default/update semantics", i, column)
+					}
+				}
+				if statement.DDL.PrimaryKey != nil || len(statement.DDL.Constraints) != 0 {
+					t.Fatalf("pk/constraints = %#v/%#v, want none",
+						statement.DDL.PrimaryKey, statement.DDL.Constraints)
+				}
+			})
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// TestExtractorT06A12NullClauseASTShape pins the clause-level distinction the
+// spec model collapses: an omitted nullability clause carries no option,
+// explicit NULL carries ColumnOptionNull, and NOT NULL carries
+// ColumnOptionNotNull — while extracted NotNull is false for both the omitted
+// and the explicit-NULL form and true only for NOT NULL. This records the
+// current representational boundary; it does not claim a new provenance
+// field.
+func TestExtractorT06A12NullClauseASTShape(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	inputs := []struct {
+		name        string
+		sql         string
+		wantOptions []ast.ColumnOptionType
+		wantNotNull bool
+	}{
+		{name: "omitted-nullability", sql: "CREATE TABLE t (c INT);",
+			wantOptions: []ast.ColumnOptionType{}, wantNotNull: false},
+		{name: "explicit-null", sql: "CREATE TABLE t (c INT NULL);",
+			wantOptions: []ast.ColumnOptionType{ast.ColumnOptionNull}, wantNotNull: false},
+		{name: "not-null", sql: "CREATE TABLE t (c INT NOT NULL);",
+			wantOptions: []ast.ColumnOptionType{ast.ColumnOptionNotNull}, wantNotNull: true},
+	}
+	for _, dialect := range []spec.Dialect{spec.DialectMySQL, spec.DialectTiDB} {
+		for _, tc := range inputs {
+			tc := tc
+			t.Run(string(dialect)+"/"+tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+				t.Parallel()
+				create, statement := parseExtractT06A12(t, dialect, tc.sql)
+				gotOptions := columnOptionTypes(create, 0)
+				if len(gotOptions) != len(tc.wantOptions) {
+					t.Fatalf("options = %v, want %v", gotOptions, tc.wantOptions)
+				}
+				for i, want := range tc.wantOptions {
+					if gotOptions[i] != want {
+						t.Fatalf("option[%d] = %v, want %v", i, gotOptions[i], want)
+					}
+				}
+				if len(statement.DDL.Columns) != 1 ||
+					statement.DDL.Columns[0].NotNull != tc.wantNotNull {
+					t.Fatalf("extracted columns = %#v, want one column notNull=%v",
+						statement.DDL.Columns, tc.wantNotNull)
+				}
+			})
+		}
+	}
+}

+// Package httpapi verifies the T06-A12 ordinary CREATE TABLE non-PK-column
+// NOT NULL contract at the HTTP seam.
+// input: POST /v1/audit bodies carrying the frozen time-exempt and
+// mixed-attribution inputs under the isolated time-allow policy
+// output: HTTP 200 with a pass payload and a one-blocker reject payload
+// bound to the owning column — policy rejects stay ordinary audit results,
+// never transport errors
+// pos: HTTP transport contract test for issue #85 T06-A12
+// note: if this file changes, update this header and module README.md.
+package httpapi
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+// TestHandlerT06A12TimeExempt posts the DATETIME NULL declaration under the
+// isolated time-allow policy — a clean pass result at HTTP 200.
+func TestHandlerT06A12TimeExempt(t *testing.T) {
+	policy := t06A8HTTPPolicy(t, map[string]string{
+		"ddl.column.not_null.require": "      required: true\n      allow_time_null: true\n",
+	})
+	code, payload := postT06A8Audit(t, policy,
+		"CREATE TABLE t (c DATETIME NULL);")
+	if code != http.StatusOK {
+		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want 200: %#v", code, payload)
+	}
+	if payload["verdict"] != "pass" {
+		t.Fatalf("verdict = %#v, want pass", payload["verdict"])
+	}
+}
+
+// TestHandlerT06A12MixedReject posts the three-column declaration under the
+// isolated time-allow policy — the reject stays a populated 200 audit result
+// carrying exactly the not_null blocker bound to the ordinary column.
+func TestHandlerT06A12MixedReject(t *testing.T) {
+	policy := t06A8HTTPPolicy(t, map[string]string{
+		"ddl.column.not_null.require": "      required: true\n      allow_time_null: true\n",
+	})
+	code, payload := postT06A8Audit(t, policy,
+		"CREATE TABLE t (ordinary INT, time_c DATETIME NULL, payload TEXT);")
+	if code != http.StatusOK {
+		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want 200: %#v", code, payload)
+	}
+	if payload["verdict"] != "reject" {
+		t.Fatalf("verdict = %#v, want reject", payload["verdict"])
+	}
+	statements, _ := payload["statements"].([]any)
+	if len(statements) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("statements = %#v, want 1", statements)
+	}
+	findings, _ := statements[0].(map[string]any)["findings"].([]any)
+	if len(findings) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("findings = %#v, want exactly one", findings)
+	}
+	finding, _ := findings[0].(map[string]any)
+	metadata, _ := finding["metadata"].(map[string]any)
+	if finding["rule_id"] != "ddl.column.not_null.require" ||
+		finding["level"] != "blocker" ||
+		finding["message"] != `column "ordinary" should be declared NOT NULL` ||
+		metadata["column"] != "ordinary" {
+		t.Fatalf("finding = %#v, want the not_null blocker bound to ordinary", finding)
+	}
+}

+// TestT06A12TimeExemptSDK runs the DATETIME NULL declaration under the

+func TestT06A12TimeExemptSDK(t *testing.T) {
+	policy := t06A10SDKPolicy(t, "ddl.column.not_null.require",
+		"      required: true\n      allow_time_null: true\n")
+	result, err := Audit(context.Background(), Request{

+		Schema:     "golden",
+		ConfigPath: policy,
+	})

+		t.Fatalf("aggregate = %s/%s, want pass/complete", result.Verdict, result.Coverage.Status)

+	if len(result.Statements) != 1 || len(result.Statements[0].Findings) != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("statements = %+v, want one statement with no findings", result.Statements)
+	}

+def t06_a12_artifact_failures(artifact, manifest):
+    """T06-A12 (issue #85): pin the per-role rule_summary contract, re-parsed
+    from the recorded raw stdout — never from a stored `parsed` blob. The six
+    isolated-profile roles carry loaded=1/applicable=1; the required=false
+    control carries loaded=1/applicable=0 (loaded but inapplicable); the
+    all-off control carries no rule_summary at all. None of these three
+    states may stand in for another."""
+    if manifest.get("task_id") != "T06":
+        return []
+    frozen = {}
+    for spec in t06_a1_contract()["cli_cases"]:
+        local = spec["id"]
+        if not local.startswith("t06-a12-"):
+            continue
+        role = local.split("-", 3)[3]
+        frozen[f"T06.cli.{local}"] = role
+    for spec in t06_a1_contract()["metadata_cases"]:
+        local = spec["id"]
+        if not local.startswith("t06-a12-"):
+            continue
+        role = local.split("-", 3)[3]
+        frozen[f"T06.meta.{local}"] = role
+    want = {
+        "ordinary-nullable": (1, 1),
+        "ordinary-not-null": (1, 1),
+        "time-exempt": (1, 1),
+        "time-required": (1, 1),
+        "text-exempt": (1, 1),
+        "mixed-attribution": (1, 1),
+        "required-false": (1, 0),
+        "disabled": None,
+    }
+    failures = []
+    for case in artifact.get("cases") or []:
+        case_id = case.get("case_id")
+        role = frozen.get(case_id)
+        if role is None:
+            continue
+        try:
+            parsed = json.loads((case.get("actual") or {}).get("stdout") or "")
+        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
+            continue  # the generic validator already reports unparseable stdout
+        expected_summary = want[role]
+        summary = parsed.get("rule_summary")
+        if expected_summary is None:
+            if summary is not None:
+                failures.append(
+                    f"T06-A12 {case_id}: rule_summary {summary!r} must be "
+                    "absent under the all-off control")
+            continue
+        want_loaded, want_applicable = expected_summary
+        got_loaded = (summary or {}).get("loaded")
+        got_applicable = (summary or {}).get("applicable")
+        if got_loaded != want_loaded or got_applicable != want_applicable:
+            failures.append(
+                f"T06-A12 {case_id}: rule_summary loaded={got_loaded!r} "
+                f"applicable={got_applicable!r} != frozen "
+                f"{want_loaded}/{want_applicable} for role {role!r}")
+    return failures
